author: Xu Han
note: Learning/portfolio demonstrator. NOT a calibrated observatory simulator, NOT an exposure-time calculator, NOT a reproduction of HARMONI/MUSE/NIRSpec, and NOT a validated performance prediction.

truth_levels.intrinsic: synthetic galaxy cube after the photon budget, before public conditioning
truth_levels.conditioned: after CALSPEC continuum shape x SkyCalc telluric x SVO Ks filter (pre-PSF)
truth_levels.observed: reduction-matched: noiseless sky-free source through the same PSF+LSF+cross-talk+weighted reconstruction (same variance weights as the science cube), post-PSF and not deconvolved; reduction-specific, not an intrinsic or strictly deterministic truth
truth_levels.reduced_recovery: noisy sky-added observation after forward-modelled sky subtraction

recovery_estimators.window_sum: fixed-window continuum-subtracted integral over +/-3 resolution elements
recovery_estimators.gaussian_fit: Gaussian+continuum least-squares fit of the aperture spectrum (flux, velocity, width, fitted R, formal errors)

gaussian_fit_quality.note: reduced_chi2 >> 1 means the Gaussian + linear-continuum model with the propagated variance does not fully describe the aperture spectrum (non-Gaussian LSF wings, telluric continuum structure), so formal fit errors are underestimated by ~sqrt(reduced_chi2); quote fit_snr_chi2_scaled.

aperture_uncertainty.covariance_aware: spatial covariance of the joint extraction propagated EXACTLY (u^T (A^T W A)^-1 u per channel), then AR(1)-inflated for the lag-1 spectral autocorrelation (approximate, NOT a full spectral covariance matrix; negative measured autocorrelation clamped to zero)
aperture_uncertainty.note: reconstructed noise is added per-pixel after the LSF and each channel reads a distinct detector column, so the isolated-noise autocorrelation is ~0 and the spectral independence is a reasonable approximation here. Spatial independence does not follow; its covariance is explicitly propagated.

provenance.name: telescope_diameter
provenance.notes: 39.0 m aperture; not a facility prediction.

provenance.name: ifu_spaxel_scale
provenance.url_or_reference: HARMONI image slicer arXiv:1807.06313; MUSE arXiv:astro-ph/0606329
provenance.notes: 10.0 mas spaxel; inspired values, not a reproduction.

provenance.name: sky_spectrum
provenance.notes: Cached SkyCalc-style sky model (radiance + telluric transmission); cache step 0.050 nm vs requested grid step 0.217 nm. Radiance uses flux-conserving detector-bin means; native samples are retained for single-LSF pipeline processing. Transmission remains point-sampled on the requested grid; this is not a high-resolution source/telluric model.

provenance.name: source_spectrum
provenance.notes: Cached source spectrum, e.g. CALSPEC/PHOENIX; energy flux density converted to a photon-count shape (x lambda), peak-normalised.

provenance.name: filter_K
provenance.notes: Cached filter curve; original e.g. SVO Filter Profile Service.

provenance.name: filter_throughput
provenance.url_or_reference: SVO 2MASS Ks transmission as a wavelength-dependent bandpass
provenance.notes: Filter curve multiplies the source spectrum (bandpass weighting), not a flat scalar.

provenance.name: sky_background
provenance.url_or_reference: native sky * filter -> spectral LSF -> detector-bin integration -> electrons
provenance.notes: Physically-motivated unit conversion; ABSOLUTE level is an engineering estimate (sky_scaling=1.0), NOT a calibrated ETC. LSF applied once before flux-conserving bin integration; source/telluric conditioning still uses the science grid.

provenance.name: ao_psf
provenance.notes: Strehl-weighted core+halo, Strehl=0.5; no real AO residual model.

provenance.name: ifu_remapping
provenance.url_or_reference: image-slicer proxy (concept: HARMONI arXiv:1807.06313, NIRSpec arXiv:physics/0512002)
provenance.notes: Rectangular slicer with deterministic trace table; not real slicer geometry.

provenance.name: detector_calibration
provenance.notes: Raw readout retained separately. Bias/dark expectation removed; shot noise remains. Known response divided out with matching variance propagation. Bad, saturated and zero-response detector samples remain masked.

provenance.name: detector_noise
provenance.url_or_reference: H2RG/H4RG-like: MOSFIRE arXiv:1208.0314, NIRSpec arXiv:2208.12686, Rauscher arXiv:1509.06264
provenance.notes: read_noise=8.0 e-, dark=0.005 e-/s; engineering proxies, not real detector cosmetics.

provenance.name: cube_reconstruction
provenance.url_or_reference: controlled inverse mapping (concept: MUSE pipeline arXiv:2006.08638, Horne 1986)
provenance.notes: Nearest + joint inverse-variance least-squares extraction of all traces per column (deblends adjacent traces; covariance (A^T W A)^-1 kept in banded form), each with its own propagated variance; not a real pipeline.

provenance.name: sky_subtraction
provenance.notes: Perfect known detector calibration; sky scaled by (1 + 0.0); the sky's photon noise stays in the data and the variance. NOT a real sky reduction or calibrated ETC.

limitations: Synthetic high-z galaxy, not a real observation.
Sky background level is an engineering_estimate, not a calibrated ETC; sky subtraction assumes a perfectly known forward-modelled sky (scale error configurable).
Recovery bias is quoted against the observed truth (post-PSF+LSF+reconstruction); no deconvolved intrinsic recovery is claimed.

Joint extraction deblends neighbouring traces without an interpolation prior. Unidentifiable voxels are masked, not interpolated; Gaussian aperture fits omit channels missing any aperture voxel and use spatial covariance. Fit errors remain conditional on the selected aperture and Gaussian model.

Explicit partial-window sums use surviving measured voxels, whereas the Gaussian fit estimates a full-aperture line from complete channels. Their fluxes can differ through missing coverage. Full-window flux/SNR are unavailable for incomplete windows; velocity moments also require positive SNR >= the reporting threshold. Negative-intensity clipping biases weak-line centroids.
median_snr excludes unavailable line windows. Read it together with line_window_measured_spaxel_fraction and unmeasured_voxel_fraction.
Continuum-median uncertainty uses a constant-continuum, independent-Gaussian approximation; the aperture is data-selected and uncertainties are conditional on that selection.
Cache wavelength coverage is not a detectability guarantee: inspect transmission_at_line, line_weighted_transmission, line_transmission_status and the detection flags.

The covariance-aware SNR uses a single lag-1 AR(1) proxy, not a full spectral covariance matrix; it is an approximate, conservative inflation (negative measured autocorrelation is clamped, factor >= 1), not a calibrated error budget.
